messages:
incident-bot: PAGED @sarah (oncall) — streaming connections (/v1/stream) showing elevated disconnects + tool-call parse errors from client SDKs. Severity: P2. Notified channel.

sarah (oncall): on it. joining — starting a rolling timeline and collecting logs. lia, can you dump any customer reports? mike/julia, tagging infra/runtime for early signals. :eyes: 

lia (support): customer-alpha and beta reported partial function-call responses and then 502s around 14:12 UTC. Customer logs show 'tool call failed: parse_error'. I'll paste snippets.

lia (support): ```
client logs:
2026-04-12T14:12:07Z ERROR function_call: "parse_error: unexpected token '\\'' in tool payload"
2026-04-12T14:12:08Z WARN stream: connection closed by server (code 1006)
```

mike (infra): nginx on pool-a shows lots of "upstream prematurely closed connection" between 14:11:50 - 14:13:30 UTC. Rolling avg disconnect rate +6.8%. kernel netstat shows many TIME_WAITs. Pushing raw logs to /infra/incident/1978203456/nginx.log (s3://redwood-incidents/1978203456/nginx.log).

julia (runtime): runtime traces show the parsing library returned a malformed JSON exception when tool-call payload size hits ~12KB. Stacktrace: ```
runtime/parser.go:312 parsePayload -> error unexpected char '\\u0000'
kvcache: evicting entry for model tok_cache size spike at 14:11:40
```

ashok (sre): hypothesis 1 — client SDK started sending a new keepalive header that broke our SSE framing -> clients see mid-stream parse errors. hypothesis 2 — a runtime change in last deployment altered parser len checks. hypothesis 3 — LB ephemeral connection resets causing truncated tool-call bodies.

sarah (oncall): list hypotheses in-thread please and mark confidence (H/M/L). I'll coordinate mitigations.

julia (runtime): H2 (runtime change) = M. I see a canary from 2026-04-12T13:55 that changed strict JSON validation in tool-call parser. Repro locally with the canary build: payloads with trailing nulls now throw.

mike (infra): H3 (LB resets) = M. Correlating timestamps with a spike in target health checks failing on pool-a. But resets started before 13:55; so not full root cause.

lia (support): H1 (client change) = L for customer-alpha, they didn't upgrade SDK until 14:30. But customer-beta did ship a quick patch at 14:05. Mixed signals.

sarah (oncall): immediate mitigations: 1) roll forward CPU headroom on pool-a by +20% (ashok) 2) temporarily revert strict parser change in runtime (julia) 3) add acceptance rule to edge to drop malformed chunks rather than cut whole SSE connection (mike). Which can we do quickly?

ashok (sre): provisioning extra capacity now, ETA 6m. Scaling group new instances spun up. I'll also increase LB idle timeout to 120s as a temporary measure.

julia (runtime): I can push a quick rollback of the parser change to the canary fleet (not full prod) and validate. If green, we can promote. Preparing patch now.

mike (infra): Edge rule change is heavier — requires deploy and frag test. Could do a partial proxy patch to accept truncated frames and attempt reassembly; risky. Prefer rollback first.

sarah (oncall): do rollback -> canary -> promote if metrics look good. ashok, confirm scaling and LB timeout done, then julia will roll. lia, continue collecting customer impact notes. I'll update pager duty timeline.

ashok (sre): LB idle timeout bumped, new instances in service (6 added). Observability: disconnect rate dropping slightly already. s3 upload of current metrics -> s3://redwood-incidents/1978203456/metrics.json

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-12t14:24:03Z - runtime/parser rollback-canary started by julia.

julia (runtime): rollback-patch applied to canary (5% traffic). Watching parsing errors and SSE disconnects. Logs show canary error rate down to baseline within 90s. Starting slow promote to 25%.

lia (support): customer-alpha reports partial recovery: they see resumed responses but some messages still missing. They're happy with reduction but want RCA.

sarah (oncall): good. timeline so far: 
- 14:11:35 UTC: small TTL/evictions in KV cache on pool-a (julia logs)
- 14:12:00 UTC: first customer parse_error report (lia)
- 14:12:07 UTC: spike in upstream closed in nginx (mike)
- 14:13:00 UTC: canary with strict parser rolled 13:55 shows errors increase
- 14:24:03 UTC: rollback canary deployed -> errors reduce

mike (infra): adding raw timeline snippet from edge logs: ```
[14:11:58] conn from 10.3.5.12 -> upstream reset
[14:12:05] client chunk len=4096 then closed mid-chunk
[14:12:06] parser: recv truncated payload len=2048 expected 4096
```

ashok (sre): mitigation status: capacity up (done), LB timeout bumped (done), rollback canary (in progress -> success on canary). Next: promote rollback to 100% after green check.

julia (runtime): promoting rollback to 100% now. Will monitor for 10m and report. If rollback stops errors, root cause likely the parser change.

lia (support): tally of impacted customers so far: 8 customers with intermittent partial responses, 2 customers with full outage windows 14:12-14:30. No billing impact reported yet.

sarah (oncall): handoff — I'm on for another 25m, then into scheduled break. If rollback holds for 10m, we'll close P2 to monitoring. If not, escalate to P1. Ashok/julia/mike stay on watch. I'll prepare post-incident RCA notes after we stabilize.

julia (runtime): rollback at 100% complete at 14:29:01 UTC. Parser errors reduced to baseline. Publishing logs tarball to s3://redwood-incidents/1978203456/artifacts.tar.gz

ashok (sre): marking mitigations complete. Will keep LB timeout for 24h then evaluate.

mike (infra): I'll run a postmortem checklist: verify no config drift, validate deployment gating, add a pre-deploy acceptance test for truncated-chunk handling.

sarah (oncall): closing action items: 
- julia: PR for parser change with tests + rollback justification (due EOD)
- mike: edge acceptance test for truncated chunks (due 48h)
- ashok: keep LB timeout change flag for 24h, then revert if safe (monitoring)
- lia: compile customer impact notes for RCA (due EOD)

lia (support): customer-alpha wants a brief postmortem email. I'll draft and link to RCA once you confirm root cause.

sarah (oncall): thanks everyone. marking thread as will convert to RCA doc in #incidents/postmortems after we collect full logs. I'll handoff active monitoring to mike at 14:55 UTC. :thumbsup:

mike (infra): taking watch at 14:55. ping me if anything spikes.

incident-bot: incident P2 -> mitigated (streaming disconnects reduced). Updates will be appended to postmortem.

sarah (oncall): final note — root cause (prelim): regression from parser strictness introduced in 2026-04-12 canary that fails on truncated chunks; manifests as tool-call parse errors and triggers client disconnects. Full RCA to follow with timeline, logs, and test additions.

---

(sarah) ACTION: create RCA doc and link artifacts (s3) in #incidents/postmortems.
